loops.name: AI Code Generation & Validation
loops.why: Continuous validation feedback refines AI generation, which produces more complex scenes that push validation limits.

loops.name: Blender to Web Pipeline
loops.why: Tighter integration between authoring tools and web engines leads to higher fidelity assets and broader adoption.

loops.name: Standards Interoperability
loops.why: Interoperability between formats drives adoption, uncovering new use cases that further drive standards alignment.

loops.name: Ontology and Semantic Web
loops.why: Semantic queries reveal structural gaps, leading to a richer object model that enables deeper semantic analysis.

loops.name: Gaussian Splatting Integration
loops.why: Native engine support for splats drives content creation, which demands better tooling and tighter standard specifications.

loops.name: Automated Benchmarking & Testing
loops.why: Automated benchmarking quantifies performance, motivating engine optimizations that enable more rigorous benchmarks.

loops.name: Archive Mirroring and Distribution
loops.why: Expanding open archives provides better training data for AI, which in turn generates more high-quality scenes to archive.

loops.name: Ecosystem Tooling and Linting
loops.why: Continuous linting of large datasets reveals edge cases, improving the linter and ensuring higher overall code quality.

loops.name: AI-Validator Loop
loops.why: Continuous automated validation of AI-generated scenes improves the LLM's understanding of the schema, leading to higher quality scene archives.

loops.name: Export-Render Loop
loops.why: Improved authoring tools generate better web-ready assets, which drives renderer adoption and further tool refinement.

loops.name: Semantic Loop
loops.why: Formalizing the standard into semantic web ontologies enables AI reasoners to write better code, validating the ontology's completeness.

loops.name: Splat Loop
loops.why: Standardizing advanced rendering techniques drives engine implementations, which stress-test the standard for future iterations.

loops.name: Interop Loop
loops.why: Seamless translation between major 3D formats increases the utility of the ecosystem as a central hub, attracting more cross-format tooling.

loops.name: QA Loop
loops.why: Rigorous automated benchmarking catches regressions early, leading to more robust engines that can handle increasingly complex test suites.

loops.name: Community Loop
loops.why: Annual conferences showcase ecosystem capabilities, attracting new developers whose feedback directly shapes the next working group priorities.

loops.name: DSPy Loop
loops.why: Programmatic optimization of LLM prompts using validation scores systematically increases the reliability of AI-generated 3D content.
